answer_1.quote: Our evaluation consists of automatic assessments on two key content-grounded generation tasks: Multi-Document Summarization (MDS) and Long-Form Question Answering (LFQA).
answer_1.outputs: Generated multi‑document summaries and long‑form QA answers, optionally with citation metadata

answer_2.quote: We incorporate both automated and human evaluations into our methodology. To evaluate the quality of the output, we follow ... and calculate Rouge-L and BertScore ... Additionally, we calculate METEOR and BLEURT20 ... To evaluate LAQuer citations ... we then calculate AutoAIS.

answer_4.quote: We report a smallscale human annotation conducted by the authors using our most promising methods. We annotated 20 examples per task... For each example, we calculate AIS at the decontextualized fact-level. Annotators were asked to make a binary classification of whether an output fact is supported by the attributed source texts.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators performed a binary classification indicating whether each output fact is supported by the cited source spans.
